summary: Iteration 2: regression + new-module testing for IIP Billing Pro production expansion. Backend pytest suite expanded from 27 to 54 cases — ALL 54 PASS (~8s). New coverage: Purchase Orders/Delivery Challans/Credit Notes (create, prefix PO/DC/CN, list filter, delete), Expenses CRUD (with persistence check), Inventory list+adjust IN/OUT+movements log+404 on bad product_id, Admin Panel (stats, users list, plan PATCH with expiry, payments, non-admin 403, admin-cannot-delete-self 400, admin-can-delete-non-admin), Razorpay graceful failure (config returns enabled=false, create-order/verify both return 400 'not configured'), Resend graceful failure (POST /api/documents/{id}/email returns 400 'not configured'). Frontend (Playwright on preview URL): admin login OK, NO 'Coming Soon' anywhere, sidebar shows all new modules incl. nav-admin for admin / hidden for free user, PO create flow generates PO/2026/000X in list, Expenses modal opens with save-expense-btn, Inventory page shows stock summary + adjust-stock-btn, Admin page renders with tab-users/tab-payments/tab-analytics, Plans choose-pro click shows graceful Razorpay toast (no crash), free user is redirected away from /admin to /.

minor.issue: Detail message hard-codes 'Add RESEND_API_KEY to backend .env' — fine for dev, but exposes internal config hints; consider a generic 'Email sending is not enabled' for prod.
Same as above — error detail mentions exact env keys (RAZORPAY_KEY_ID/SECRET). Acceptable in dev.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend fires several /api/admin/* requests that return 403 BEFORE the route guard redirects to '/'. No crash, just noisy console errors. Move the role check ahead of the data fetch (or render guard) so non-admins never call admin endpoints.

issues: Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on initial render (pre-existing from iter-1, not blocking).
DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description (Radix a11y warning) — pre-existing pattern in the app.

action_items: (Optional) On /admin page, gate the data-fetch effect on user.role === 'admin' so non-admins never trigger 403s to /api/admin/*.
(Optional, carryover from iter-1) Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to all Radix DialogContent wrappers (Expense add modal still missing).
(Optional) Use generic error messages for /api/payments/create-order and /api/documents/{id}/email instead of leaking the exact env var names.
critical_code_review_comments: gen_doc_number() now uses a monotonic counter via db.counters.find_one_and_update — good fix from iter-1.

build_document() still does NOT restore stock on PUT/DELETE of an invoice (iter-1 comment unresolved). Editing or deleting an invoice will leave product stock incorrect. Suggested fix: in documents_update, compute delta between old and new items[].qty per product_id and adjust; in documents_delete, re-add the qty back.

Inventory.adjust path does write a stock_movements log but does NOT cap stock at 0 — stock can go negative on 'out' adjustments. Add a guard or accept negative as a business decision (currently undocumented).
Admin.delete_user only blocks deleting admin-role users; it does NOT cascade-delete the user's documents/customers/products/expenses. Orphaned data will accumulate.
PATCH /api/admin/users/{uid}/plan accepts any string for plan (no enum validation). A typo like 'Pro' (capitalized) or 'enterprise' would silently set an unsupported plan.
Email and payments errors detail strings reveal the exact .env keys to the client — minor info disclosure.
server.py is now 881 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into routers (auth.py, documents.py, payments.py, admin.py, inventory.py, expenses.py).
CORS allow_credentials=True + allow_origins='*' (default) is still non-compliant when cookies are ever used (auth currently uses Bearer, so OK).
test_credentials: admin@iipbilling.com / Admin@123 (premium). Free users registered ad-hoc as TEST_free_<uuid>@example.com / Test@1234.
seed_data_creation: All test data prefixed 'TEST' / 'UI TEST' and cleaned up via session-scoped fixture (customers + products). Expenses/movements/test-deleted users persist but are clearly marked TEST.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — 54 pytest cases, runs in ~8s. New cases cover PO/DC/CN, Expenses, Inventory (incl. movements), Admin (stats/users/plan-update/payments/role-guard/self-delete-block), Razorpay+Resend graceful 400s. Razorpay and Resend keys are intentionally empty — DO NOT report 'not configured' 400s as bugs. Known cosmetic console items (carry-over): Recharts -1 width/height warnings on dashboard, Radix DialogContent aria-describedby warnings. Free user visiting /admin currently shows 403s in console before redirect — flagged as minor integration polish item, not blocking.
rca of the issue: No production-blocking bugs found. Razorpay/Resend correctly degrade with 400 + clear UI message + mailto fallback. Main carry-over: invoice edit/delete does not roll back product stock — could cause inventory drift in production. All other modules (PO, DC, CN, Expenses, Inventory, Admin) function end-to-end at API and UI level.
